name: research-toolkit
description: Even-handed investigation of loaded, contested topics. Research & investigation skills for thinking-with-AI - investigation protocols (deep-investigation, cui-bono / "follow the money", screening a dev job or employer for hidden military/defense ties), text & source deconstruction, frame rotation, and iterative verification that escalates to a recursive adversarial dialectic (generate a claim's exact opposite and test it). The skepticism is symmetric - turned on the consensus, the contrarian take, the model's own bias, and its own conclusions; it assumes no villain in advance (POSIWID: judge a method by what it does, not what it claims). Ships two deliberately basic MCP servers - thin data-access layers, not analysis engines; the skills do the analysis: financial-mcp (stock price, history, company info and standard technical indicators via yfinance, with a local ticker cache) and transparency-mcp (keyless public data - US Congress bills/members/votes via GovTrack, World Bank development indicators, and US nonprofit Form 990 filings via ProPublica).

firing_filter.title: Firing filter (deterministic firing layer)
firing_filter.description: Master switch for the zero-model firing layer (words arm, situations inject one guidance each, blocks only on claim-vs-record facts). Disabling removes the toolkit's only layer that fires without anyone noticing anything - every recorded failure was caught by a human, none by self-review; the prose rules alone are the layer that failed silently on record. Runtime control per session: /research-toolkit:firing-filter [status|on|off].
